t: Letter From Public Safety Bureau Re Communist Publication "Modern Civilization"

pages.en:
cep
February 16, 33.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.22 of February 11 regarding a communist publication
entitled "Modern Civilization" (現代文化) and to
inform you that the matter will receive attention.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

F. W. Garre
Commissioner of Police.

General Wen Hung-en,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

逕覆者准
貴局二月十一日致
函為查禁反動刊物
書由准此現已從事
應亟覆即希
查照為荷此致
上海市公安局局長
警務科長
陳立夫

此致，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. & REGISTRY.
D 4499
16 / 2 / 33

Translation of confidential despatch dated February 11,
1933,No.22, Character "Tseng" ( 政 ), from General Wen
Hung En, Chief of the Public Safety Bureau to the
Commissioner of the Shanghai Municipal Police.
----------

This Bureau is in receipt of a secret order
No.552 from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, stating
that the Central Propaganda Committee has sent a letter
to the Executive Committee of the Shanghai Kuomintang
Headquarters to the effect that a periodical entitled
"Modern Civilization" (現代文化) published by the Modern
Civilization Society (現代文化社), is a publication of
the Communist Party. The Municipality is therefore
requested to prohibit the publication of this periodical.
Apart from instructing the Shanghai Mail Censorship
Department to cooperate with the Educational Bureau of
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to detain all
copies of the publication in question and my subordinates
to pay attention to the publication, I hereby request
you to render assistance in this matter.

Sealed : Wen Hung En.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
文书与档案室。
D 4499
1933年2月16日

翻译自上海市公安局局长温应恩将军于一九三三年二月十一日发给上海公共租界工部局警务处处长的机密公函，第22号，字“政”。
----------

本局收到大上海市政府第552号密令，称中央宣传部已致函中国国民党上海特别市党部执行委员会，指出由现代文化社出版的名为《现代文化》的期刊系共产党刊物。因此，要求市政府禁止该期刊的出版。除指令上海邮件检查所与大上海市政府教育局合作，扣留所有相关刊物副本，并饬令下属注意该出版物外，特此请求阁下在此事上提供协助。

盖章：温应恩。
